# Cindy personal skill modules

Extracted from `makecindy/cindy` at `5f0b5f42b46969c3ac21b0cd798a07e36b46e8fd`, with per-file original and local hashes in `SOURCE.json`. The repository's upstream Apache license and NOTICE remain at the plugin root. This newer source is intentionally separate from the earlier renderer baseline.

The original store, metadata reader, streamed summaries, byte-bounded native projection, runtime cache and query index are retained. The store's error class uses an explicit field instead of a TypeScript parameter property. The metadata parser resolves its isolated YAML scalar through the plugin's existing gray-matter dependency; its original parsing logic is unchanged. The summary iterator accepts an optional migration flag so read-only session queries preserve original files. Its default and trusted native projection retain upstream migration behavior. Projection and query index remain byte-identical to upstream.

The runtime cache additionally accepts an optional caller-supplied source metadata stamp. The adapter reuses its existing streamed path scan to aggregate entrypoint identity, size, nanosecond mtime and ctime, without reading bodies or retaining a full source list. The aggregate is independent of directory enumeration order; runtime includes enabled entrypoints, while query includes both enabled and disabled entrypoints. This freshness evidence supplements the original watchers, directory checks, LRU and serialized writers when a watcher event is missed. It is not a content digest or an atomic filesystem snapshot. Callers omitting the optional stamp retain upstream behavior.

Five original real-filesystem test files are adapted. Store tests only retarget imports. Cache tests also verify that metadata observed during a held build invalidates it before publishing. Stream tests retain the installed js-yaml parser as their independent expected-value oracle. Query/projection tests call the extracted modules directly instead of the unported Electron service; the Electron authority case and unrelated Pi/Codex configuration assertions are omitted. These tests do not establish Paseo authority or provider loading. Every test adaptation is recorded in `SOURCE.json`.

These are internal storage and projection primitives, not public RPC handlers. Profile/session authority, path admission, deletion coordination, mutation receipts and shutdown draining belong to the Paseo service adapter. Projection of native skill mounts does not establish that a provider loaded them. Current public Paseo APIs do not supply verified per-agent skill mounts; no global skill directory or provider configuration is modified by this extraction.

The modules live under `server/vendor/skills/` because Paseo production modules must belong to `client/`, `server/` or `shared/`. This placement change preserves all six module bytes; only consuming imports and the test provenance paths change.
